## Description

Buys a convertible bond and hedges some equity delta, aiming to capture mispricing across bond value, embedded equity option and credit risk.

## Where it may fit

Mispriced convertibles with liquid hedges and favorable volatility/credit conditions; generally specialist rather than retail-scale.

## Vehicles

Convertible-arbitrage hedge funds and multi-strategy funds.

## Required data

Convertible terms, bond prices/yields, equity price, implied volatility, credit spreads, borrow costs, rates and call/put/convertibility clauses.

## Caveats

Requires specialist pricing and hedging; liquidity, borrow recalls, issuer credit deterioration and jump risk can dominate modeled spread.
